selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators

facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of P-8303

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control RESPIRATORY_PROTECTION_PROGRAM: the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators on P-8303 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling airborne contaminants, specifically monitoring dust, fume and gas exposure. P-8303 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 23 July 2013 a hazard report was recorded on P-8303 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during transfer operations; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
